data.text: China drafts export controls on 23 AI technologies — including large models and agents.  High-compute or top-ranked models face new restrictions. Open-source may get fast-track licensing.  Big potential shift for the global open-model ecosystem.  #AI #China #ExportControls

AI borders are changing.
China proposes export controls on 23 AI technologies, while exempting already-public open-source work and excluding API access. A country may let the world use its AI without letting the world own it. Access and sovereignty are not the same thing.
